body:
WHAT
After `/settings <key> <value>` (or set_model) persists a setting, the engine mirrors it into the live Settings object and prints a note saying when the change applies: 'Applied to the current session.', 'Takes effect on the next turn.', 'Takes effect after restarting magentra.' or 'Takes effect after /clear (new session).' The mapping `SETTING_TIMING` is typed over every key of the settings schema, so adding a schema key without a timing entry fails to compile. Connection keys (provider, baseUrl, apiKey, apiKeyEnv, allowInsecureTls) are 'session' because the provider is rebuilt on the spot.

WHY
The note is the only feedback the user gets about whether their change took; a wrong or missing note makes a live change look like it needs a restart, or a restart-only change look live.

WHERE
engine/core/src/runtime/engine.ts — SETTING_TIMING (Record<keyof typeof settingsSchema.shape, SettingTiming>), SETTING_TIMING_NOTE, CONNECTION_SETTING_KEYS, Engine.applySettingLive(key, value) (setSettingPath into opts.settings, rebuildProvider() for connection keys, returns the note), Engine.handleSettings(), Engine.handleSetModel(). Schema keys from engine/core/src/config/settings.ts — settingsSchema, setSettingPath(), setSetting().

TEST CHECKLIST
1. Object.keys(SETTING_TIMING).sort() deep-equals Object.keys(settingsSchema.shape).sort() and has length 24; every value is one of session|nextTurn|restart|clear.
2. slash_command '/settings model x' emits command_output containing 'Set model = "x"', the written file path, and 'Takes effect on the next turn.'; the FakeProvider's next request uses model 'x'.
3. '/settings hooks.x y' style keys resolve timing by top-level key: '/settings search.enabled false' prints 'Takes effect on the next turn.' and '/settings permissions.allow …' prints the /clear note.
4. '/settings baseUrl http://localhost:1' prints 'Applied to the current session.' and rebuildProvider is invoked (observable via the provider the next request goes to).
5. An unknown key ('/settings nope 1') prints the setSetting error listing valid keys and no timing note; the settings file is unchanged.
